_doc: MEASURED HARNESS PARITY PER LANE — the machine-readable store the EG2b threshold gate reads. A study may not grade a lane whose parity sits below `threshold_pct` unless the artifact states the parity number in its LIMITS/CAVEATS section. This makes 'don't trust grinder studies' mechanical instead of a thing somebody has to remember.
_rule: EG2b, rig/test_shipset_20260804.py. Seeded 2026-08-17 from harness_parity_20260817_out.json. Rewritten by data/killtests/harness_parity_v2_20260818.py whenever a stamped day is graded.
_threshold_note: Starts at 90. It is a FLOOR ON TRUST, not a target to tune toward: raising it makes the gate stricter, lowering it needs Marcos.
_method_note: batch_secs=60 nominal cadence, exact price+stop, |dt| <= 300s. This is NOT an equivalence test: the two sides were not fed the same bars, so a miss cannot be attributed between the detector and the feed. It is also DEPRESSED by the A1 duplicate-fire defect — the live denominators below include restart replays (grinder 66 rows / 53 distinct, v2 164 / 150, bandpass 9 / 8). Both problems are fixed forward: the A2 provenance stamps shipped 2026-08-17 night and 2026-08-18 is the first day supporting exact_fed_stream parity.

prevwap.note: N=3. 100% on three fires is not a strong claim; it is the absence of a disagreement.

kevseq.note: no duplicates measured; the gap is feed/ctx reconstruction, not restarts

grinder.note: WORST LANE. Denominator includes 13 restart-replay duplicates (53 distinct). DO NOT GRADE THE GRINDER LANE FROM HARNESS OUTPUT without stating this number.

flat_top.note: N=3. The break-attack cell fired exactly three times on 8/17 (IPST/CDTG/LBGJ, all 09:30) and the extracted core reproduces all three from the tape, within 37s. 100% on three fires is the ABSENCE OF A DISAGREEMENT, not a strong claim. LEVELS: w_high matches to the cent on 2/3, w_low on 1/3 — IPST's base reads 8.1399/7.49 off our 10s SIP roll vs 8.09/7.46 off the broker's M1. That is a FEED difference (it moves the stop 3c) and cannot be attributed to the detector from this day. DENOMINATOR BOUND: this counts LIVE fires only. Replayed over all 56 captured names the core also attacks on 29 names the live bot never fired on — the live funnel (scanner board membership, slot limits, found_entry/traded suppression, an existing retest arm) sits UPSTREAM of the detector and is not modelled here. The harness grades the DETECTOR, never the funnel; a flat_top study must say so.
